candidate_operator: Delta L = - M_Pl^2 eta4/(2 X_star) (D^2 Sigma)^2
normalization_scope: eta4 is dimensionless in the stated normalization; this target concerns only this minimal scalar higher-spatial operator

local_rest_effect.dispersion_if_eta4_positive: omega^2 = eta4 k^4/(mu_K^2+k^2) before any additional higher-spatial gravity operators

rolling_branch_contamination.exact_ratio: R_HS = eta4 u^2 p^2/(M_K^2 c_a^2) = eta4 Q k_com^2 a/(mu_K^2 x0)

reference.role: historical independently replay-certified RTK local reference; refresh if a new RTK production reference supersedes it

requested_outputs: reconstruct H0/c, mu_K and x0 from the frozen production closure
verify the exact identity M_K^2 c_a^2=mu_K^2 Q x
verify d ln(aQ)/d ln a = 1-3r/(Q s^2)>0 throughout 0<=z<=1 for this reference, so z=0 is the worst contamination point at fixed comoving k
report R_HS/eta4 at k_com=5h/Mpc and z=0
invert the ratio for contamination tolerances 1%, 0.5%, 0.1%, and 0.01%
interpretation_rule: The output is a tuning/compatibility bound for this operator, not an acceptance threshold for UV completion. A small allowed eta4 does not by itself falsify the model, and a value satisfying the bound does not establish radiative naturalness or a healthy cutoff.
non_claims: does not prove this is the unique higher-spatial completion
does not include higher-spatial metric/U1 operators or cancellations among several operators
does not establish technical naturalness of a tiny eta4
does not compute a scattering cutoff
does not replace a full likelihood replay with eta4 nonzero
does not use a new best-fit RTK point; it is tied to the historical certified reference until that reference is superseded
next_gate: compare the required eta4 window with finite-amplitude local-rest canonical dynamics and with radiative generation estimates; then test a minimal multi-operator higher-spatial basis if a single eta4 term is too tuned
